idea-plugin.name: Claude Code sessions
idea-plugin.description:
Export and import Claude Code chat sessions - built for moving them to another machine and another user.
The plugin reads the local Claude Code session transcripts (~/.claude/projects/<project>/<sessionId>.jsonl, plus the per-session auxiliary folder next to each transcript), lets you pick the conversations you want to move and writes them into a portable ZIP archive. On import, the sessions are attached to the local project folder you choose and their timestamps are shifted so they show up as sessions that just happened, not old ones.
  • Tools | Claude Code sessions | Export Sessions... pick one or more sessions and save the archive.
  • Tools | Claude Code sessions | Import Sessions... pick an archive, the target project folder and which sessions to restore.

action.description: Export the selected Claude Code chat sessions into a ZIP archive
